growing_window.label: March to June
growing_window.chosen_as: the window marked primary in pixel_trend_long_record

pixels.not_stored_rule: fewer than 15 seasons with a value (they have no slope in pixel_trend_long_record either)

slope_check.method: Theil-Sen slope of the stored 5 decimal values on the year, times 10, against band 1 of the trend raster (float32)

window_vs_catchment.summary: Across the full 176 x 131 cached MOD13Q1 window (23056 tested pixels with at least 15 seasons), median Theil-Sen slope is +0.00489 NDVI per decade (2865 upward and 37 downward pixels passing the window-wide false discovery rate check at q = 0.05). Inside the catchment (8094 tested pixels), median pixel slope is +0.00757 NDVI per decade (1943 upward and 7 downward trend-FDR pixels; 1165 upward and 1 downward Pettitt change-point FDR pixels), compared with +0.00392 NDVI per decade across the 14962 tested pixels outside the catchment polygon.

regional_scan.ranking_rule: Zones from place_config.stratum_masks are ranked descending by total false discovery rate (FDR q = 0.05) trend area share (upward plus downward), then Pettitt change-point FDR area share, then absolute median Theil-Sen slope per decade.

archive_gaps: No composite period is absent from Planetary Computer in the registered period.
limitations: Each value is one 250 m MODIS pixel's mean over the composites of one growing window that passed the reliability filter, not a measurement of any field, pasture or plant. A season where fewer than half of the periods were kept at a pixel has no value there.
NDVI measures how green the ground looks from above, not forage, palatability or species.
Spring windows include snow-covered ground at the upper pixels in some seasons; earlier or later melt can move a season's value with no change in the plants.

Terra's overpass has drifted earlier since 2020, from 10:30 to about 9:06 mean local time by December 2025 (NASA): later seasons are seen with a lower sun and longer shadows in mountain terrain, which may shift NDVI without any change on the ground.
Composites from 12 July 2025 to the end of 2025 are absent from Planetary Computer; a season window that includes them holds fewer composites.

The values are an input to pixel_trend_long_record, not a second analysis. A run of high or low seasons seen when stepping through them is not a trend or a cause; the slope, its interval and the false discovery rate check are in pixel_trend_long_record.
